basis.type: Scope clarification only; original rules are correct.
basis.rationale: F01's six colony spaces and the expected answer's colony six/research five are true source-backed descriptions. However the literal question asks which player count governs track selection and how many of each are selected, without asking for a separate printed-space tally. Its counts are operationally resolved by selecting the exact six-player colony and five-player research configurations plus six five-player Confluence cards. Treating failure to restate those labels as explicit space-count numerals as an additional substantive omission adds a scope requirement; treating spaces as physical selected cards would also be incorrect.
basis.proposed_correction: Retain the source-correct key answer. Clarify F01 as: select the complete six-player colony-track configuration because Kjas counts twice only there (six spots is an equivalent explanatory description). Clarify F02 as: select the complete five-player research-track configuration and six Confluence cards appropriate to the actual five players (five research spots is an equivalent explanatory description). Do not add separate explicit printed-space-count omission gates. If an independent space tally is intended, revise the question prospectively to ask how many bid spaces are in each track. No benchmark input was modified.
